about.description: The Gulf is a waterfront hideaway with a casual chic atmosphere offering fresh seafood fare and handcrafted cocktails. Located at two beachside locations in Orange Beach and Okaloosa Island (Fort Walton Beach), the restaurant features a design with shipping containers, reclaimed, recycled and salvaged building materials that contrast with the sand, surf and palms.
about.elevator_pitch: A casual-chic waterfront restaurant specializing in fresh Gulf Coast seafood and cocktails with stunning water views.
about.vibe: Enchanting seaside setting with casual elegance, warm and inviting atmosphere, beach-house vibes with open-air seating
about.reservations: Available for special events and catering
about.insider_tip: Revolving seasonal menu featuring the freshest local ingredients; ask about the daily fresh catch
